title: Detection of iNOS/TNF in cells of the small intestinal lamina propria by FACS
protocol: Remove small intestine between stomach and cecum.
Keep the intestine in a 50ml tube with wash intestine buffer on ice, gently removing additional tissue or fat.
Flush gut with 10ml cold wash intestine buffer using gavage needle.
In petri dish with wash intestine buffer, remove remaining mesenteric tissue and fat with forceps under light from a Rx projector.
Locate remaining Peyer's patches. Excise by pinching PPs with forceps and cutting as close as possible with scissors.
Use flat part of scissors to gently expel remaining mucus and feces.
In new petri dish containing wash intestine buffer, open intestine along the length with scissors.
Cut gut into small pieces (5mm) in a 50ml conical tube with 20ml cold wash intestine buffer.
Invert several times, vortexing and pour off supernatant. Refill tube and repeat 2 more times.
Transfer gut pieces to 50ml falcon tubes containing 20ml pre-warm (37°C) intestinal EDTA buffer.
Vortex and incubate with shaking platform for 20 minutes at 37°C.
Vortex tube on high for 15 seconds.
Allow pieces to settle. Discard supernatant in waste.
Add 20ml of intestinal EDTA buffer and repeat steps vortexing, incubating, and settling until clear.
Put pieces of tissue in a gauze and wash pieces with wash intestine buffer twice.
Remove remaining EDTA before proceeding.
Transfer pieces to 50ml falcon tubes containing 20ml digestion buffer.
Add 5mg of collagenase 4 and 0.5mg of DNaseI.
Incubate in water bath for 1 hour at 37°C, vortexing every 15 minutes.
Pour supernatant through a 70um nylon filter into a 50ml tube.
Wash the cells with 5 ml of PBS.
Spin the cells at 1200 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C.
Repeat steps 1 and 2.
Resuspend cells (1-10 million) in 1ml of PBS.
Add 1ml of Aqua and mix well.
Incubate at 4 °C for 30 min, protected from the light.
Add 1 ml of PBS to wash the cells.
Spin the cells at 1200 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C.
Repeat steps 7 and 8 once.
Divide cell suspensions into two wells for specific and isotype control staining per sample.
Prepare surface antibody cocktail in FACS Buffer.
Add 50 μl/well of the prepared surface antibody cocktail.
Incubate at 4 °C for 30 min, protected from light.
Wash cells twice in FACS buffer, spinning at 1200 rpm for 5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend cells in 100 μl/well Cytofix/Cytoperm.
Incubate resuspended cells for 20 min at 4 °C.
Wash cells twice with 1x Perm/Wash diluted in water.
Resuspend cells in 50 ml of intracellular staining cocktail.
Spin the cocktail at 5000 rpm for 10 min before using it.
Incubate for 20 min at 4°C.
Wash twice in 1x Perm/wash buffer diluted in water.
Re-suspend cells in 200 μl of FACS buffer.
Store samples at 4°C until ready to run FACS.
Acquire samples in a LSRII machine using BD Compensation beads for compensation and application settings.
